test_vmap_batched_outputs: test vmap batched outputs by comparing loop results against vmap results for an op
generate_exhaustive_batched_inputs: generate all combinations of batched tensor inputs with batch dims at position 0 or -1
skip_ops_in_test_suite: skip or mark specific ops as expected failures in the functorch test suite
override_op_tolerance: override numerical tolerance for specific ops in the functorch test suite
check_vmap_fallback_behavior: check if an op fails when vmap fallback is disabled and print xfail entries
